Name: Fish Tank Bubble Toggle
Author: StarAmy
Description:
[size=4][b]Fish Tank Bubble Toggle is back for 1.6!
[/b]
With this mod running, bubbles are [b]disabled [/b]by default, but resume working like normal once you place the "Fish Tank Bubbler" in. It is [b]invisible [/b]once placed in the tank (it does cast an odd shadow, but that can be easily masked with other decor).

They do work with new fish tanks added through content patcher, and will be tested/updated to work with Furniture Framework tanks soon. Tanks changed with AT packs are also funky, but this will be updated when I can because I want to add more critters to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25615?tab=description]Lark's Tarantula Enclosures[/url]!

Buy them from Willy at the Fish Shop for $25 each or craft them with 25 stone each.

New fish, critters, and decorations intended for dry tanks coming soon(ish).
